story-context.constraints: Privacy-first logging with zero telemetry by default Structured logging with JSON format and correlation IDs Chromium integration using base/logging.h patterns Consent-gated error reporting and diagnostics upload Resource monitoring without performance impact Scalability patterns for AI inference and MCP connections

tests.standards: Unit tests: Vitest for TypeScript diagnostics, gtest for C++ diagnostics components. Integration tests: Cross-process logging validation, Mojo IPC diagnostics communication. Performance tests: Resource usage monitoring, logging overhead measurement. Security tests: PII filtering validation, consent-gated diagnostics. Scalability tests: Load testing for AI inference queues, MCP connection pools. 80% minimum test coverage. AAA pattern for all tests. Result<T> pattern for error handling. Mock external dependencies appropriately.
tests.locations: src/toubkal/app/core/diagnostics/ - TypeScript diagnostics component tests src/toubkal/components/diagnostics/ - C++ diagnostics component tests src/toubkal/tests/integration/ - Integration tests for logging and monitoring systems src/toubkal/tests/performance/ - Performance and scalability tests src/toubkal/tests/security/ - Security testing for diagnostics (PII filtering, consent validation)
tests.ideas: AC1-Logging-infrastructure: Test structured logging with JSON format, privacy-safe logging (no PII), log filtering by level and component, C++/TypeScript integration AC2-Error-tracking: Test error capture with stack traces, error aggregation and deduplication, consent-gated reporting, global error handlers AC3-Performance-monitoring: Test AI inference latency tracking, network request monitoring, resource usage metrics, performance budget alerts AC4-Scalability-framework: Test AI inference queue management, MCP connection pooling, audit log rotation, background task scheduling AC5-Developer-tools: Test diagnostics dashboard accessibility, live log streaming, performance profiling, state inspection with export functionality
